name: Notch Tabs Hero
description: Centered hero with a white notched tab bar (inverse-corner radial-gradient shoulders) overlapping a brand gradient showcase; switching tabs blurs the screenshot out (scale .949, 15px drop, 4px blur over 250ms) and springs the next one back in.
interactions: notched tab bar: 52px white bar, radius 0 0 32 32, with 32x32 inverse-corner shoulders drawn by radial-gradient(circle at 0%/100% 100%, transparent 32px, surface 32.5px) — geometry verbatim

tab switch: shot animates out 250ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) to scale(.949) translateY(15px) blur(4px) opacity 0; src swaps at 260ms; springs back in 350ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.64,1) with 300ms ease-out opacity/blur; busy lock releases 380ms after the swap
tab pill highlight and label color crossfade 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
badge background tint deepens on hover, 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
brand text marks: opacity .4 to 1 on hover, 150ms
per-tab screenshots are preloaded on init so the mid-animation swap never flashes
prefers-reduced-motion: all transitions off, tab click swaps the image instantly
